title.narrative: Supporting African Union Commission (AUC) in the implementation of the Decade of Education 2025-2034

description.narrative: The African Union Decade of Education and Skills Development (2025–2034) represents a historic, continent-wide commitment to accelerate the transformation of Africa’s education and skills ecosystems. Despite progress under the Continental Education Strategy for Africa (CESA 16–25) and other AU-led frameworks, substantial gaps persist in access, equity, quality, relevance, and financing of education across Member States. The Decade responds to these systemic challenges by dedicating the next ten years to urgent, holistic, and strategic reforms aimed at building inclusive, resilient, and future-ready education systems. The initiative is underpinned by five strategic imperatives that collectively drive the transformation of Africa’s educational landscape. It seeks to respond urgently to critical learning and skills gaps while enhancing policy coherence and sustainable financing across the continent. By reinforcing the role of education as a cornerstone for peace, resilience, and stability, the initiative directly drives the implementation of CESA 26–35 and Agenda 2063 commitments. Furthermore, it is strategically positioned to capitalize on Africa’s significant demographic dividend and rapid technological advancements, ensuring that the continent’s youth are equipped for the demands of the 21st century. It proposes a continent-wide push to consolidate gains, scale innovations, and drive inclusive, technology-enabled, and competency-based learning transformation from 2025 to 2034. Anchored on the foundational pillars of Continental Education Strategy for Africa (CESA 26–35), the New TVET Strategy 2025-2034 and the New STISA 2034 and aligned with the broader vision of Agenda 2063, the Decade serves as a unifying platform to coordinate national, regional, and continental efforts; ensure policy coherence; and mobilize stakeholders toward shared education and skills development priorities.
